name: RC-B10-0191/2024 – After § 5 – Am 9
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text: 5a. Calls on the President of Russia, Vladimir Putin, and the President of Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, to immediately engage in peace talks to end the armed conflict and bloodshed, using all available diplomatic means; emphasises that the priority of these efforts should be the protection of human lives and the pursuit of a just and lasting agreement that ensures stability and security in the region;
